inputs.subject: Riverfront Logistics: Financial Narrative, CAC & LTV
inputs.body:
Here is the guidance for the internal financial materials regarding Riverfront Logistics, routed here as per your preference for handling confidential company financials.

Current Metrics Overview:
- Cash: $1.5M
- Runway: 6 months (Note: at a $72K/mo burn rate, $1.5M would typically imply ~20 months of runway. You may want to clarify in your materials if the 6-month figure accounts for upcoming large expenditures, debt obligations, or a planned increase in burn to ensure the narrative is airtight).
- Burn Rate: $72K/month
- Last Quarter Revenue: $1.8M (Strong run rate of ~$7.2M annualized)

Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC):
Formula: Total Sales & Marketing Expenses / Number of New Customers Acquired.
Narrative tip: Show how your CAC is trending over time. If it's decreasing, it shows growing brand presence and marketing efficiency. 

Lifetime Value (LTV):
Formula: (Average Revenue Per Account x Gross Margin) / Customer Churn Rate.
Narrative tip: Internal stakeholders and investors typically look for an LTV:CAC ratio of at least 3:1. Given your strong quarterly revenue of $1.8M, highlighting a high LTV will justify your acquisition costs and demonstrate sustainable growth.

If you have the specific sales/marketing spend and customer counts on hand, reply with them and I can calculate the exact LTV and CAC figures for your presentation!
